_comment: Elevate Marketing Italia, /italy. Built from 'Claude Design brief 1 av 2: landingssider, Elevate Marketing Italia (v2)', 14 October 2026. Variant A1 (canoni) only. Copy is in copy.json, routing in routing.json. This funnel is a deliberately separate copy of /uk-it-firms: own code, own consent key, own scripts, so that a change to one cannot break the other.
_live: While false every page carries noindex and the lead endpoint refuses every submission with a 503. The build refuses true while anything below is outstanding, and says what.
_indexable: Whether the landing page may be indexed once live. Outcome pages are always noindex. Leave false until someone decides the Italian page should rank; true while live is false fails the build.
_proofread: Set true when Aurora has proofread every Italian string. Required for live.
_legalApproved: Set true when the Italian adviser has approved every line marked ADVISOR in the brief: consent text, banner, footer, the privacy and cookie notices, the wording about compensation and about who owns data and ideas. Required for live.

variables._pending: Both are open decisions. The brief says to render them literally, so the page shows {THRESHOLD} and {OFFER} as written. Replace with the real text (for example 'da 10 a 150 dipendenti'); the build refuses live while either still reads as a placeholder. If the band is not 10 to 150, the options of question 2 and routing.json must change with it.

links._comment: The privacy and cookie notices are legal text delivered separately and are not built here. The links point where those pages will be; the build refuses live until public/italy/privacy and public/italy/cookie exist. terms is null: the brief says to omit the link if no terms page exists at launch.

consent._textSha256: First 16 hex digits of the sha256 of the consent checkbox label in copy.json. The build fails if the wording changes without this being updated, so that a new wording cannot be recorded under the old version. Change the wording: bump version, then set this to the value the build prints.

funnel._pixelId: Not given in the brief. The brief wants the Italian pixel loaded only from /italy pages and only after Accetto. Empty means nothing is ever loaded. Decide whether Italy gets its own pixel or shares the UK one before any ad runs: sharing means sharing optimisation data.
funnel._calendlyUrl: Event URL with no query string, from a separate Italian event type on the Italian representative's calendar. Not the UK link. Required for live.
